svg.text: #586 Enterprise Multi-LoRA Serving: Paged S-LoRA/vLLM vs. 16K Few-Shot ICL vs. Dedicated Pods
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Serve 200 Tenant LoRAs (r=32, 268MB each) on 4× H200 ($13.6k/mo vs. $920k/mo Dedicated) · +8.4% TPOT Overhead
1. Multi-LoRA HBM Layout & Pinned Host DRAM Swap
Shared Base Model (Llama-3.3-70B / Qwen2.5-72B-FP8 on TP=2 H200)
• Base Weights: 72.0 GB total (36.0 GB/GPU) — Loaded ONCE for all 200 tenants
• Batched Base GEMM Y_0 = X · W_0 runs at full Tensor Core efficiency
Hot HBM LoRA Pool (max_loras = 64 Active Adapters Resident in HBM)
• Per-Adapter Size (r=32, 7 linear modules, FP16): 268.4 MB (134.2 MB/GPU @ TP=2)
• 64 Hot Adapters in HBM = 17.18 GB total (8.59 GB/GPU) · Punica BGMV +8.4% TPOT
Warm Pinned Host DRAM Pool (max_cpu_loras = 256 · PCIe 5.0 52 GB/s)
• Cold-to-Hot Adapter Swap Latency: 134.2 MB ÷ 52 GB/s = 2.6ms–5.2ms (Async Layer-wise)
• Zero disk I/O stall during tenant context switches
2. 100-Tenant Customization Matrix (60 QPS Total)
A. 100 Dedicated Fine-Tuned Pods (100 × 2 H100 = 200× H100)
• Cost: $460,000/mo · Avg GPU Utilization: 2.8% (Severe long-tail idle waste)
B. Shared Base Model + 16K Few-Shot In-Context Learning (ICL)
• 100 tenants × 16K examples = 3.4TB KV Cache → HBM Prefix Cache Thrashing (48% miss)
• Requires 10× H200 ($34,000/mo) · P95 TTFT: 620ms · Domain Style F1: 84.5%
C. Shared Base Model + vLLM/S-LoRA Dynamic Multi-LoRA [RECOMMENDED]
• Zero few-shot prompt bloat (512-tok prompt) · P95 TTFT: 145ms · Domain F1: 95.8%
• Fleet for 60 QPS across 100 Tenants: 4× H200 ($13,600/mo, -97.0% vs Dedicated, -60% vs ICL)
3. Production Multi-LoRA Hand-Calculation Formula (70B Base · Rank r=32)
• Single LoRA Adapter Size = 2 × L(80) × N_mod(7) × d_model(8192) × r(32) × 2B = 268.4 MB (vs. 342 MB for a SINGLE 16K GQA-8 KV Cache!)
• Key Insight: Storing a tenant's permanent r=32 LoRA adapter in HBM (268 MB) is SMALLER than caching one 16K few-shot prompt KV block!
